title: Researches on the molecular mechanism of AML with normal karyotype
description: Exploit target genes which are involve in the pathogenesis of AML with normal karyotype through compare the differences of transcriptomes between the AML patients′ leukemic cells and the healthy donors′ immature mononuclear cells; Verify the function of target genes.
